report_title: AgentShieldAI Dataset Compatibility & Model Input Inspection

xgboost.feature_semantics: Engineered agent tool authorization, parameter depth, and 171 one-hot tool IDs

isolation_forest.normal_behavior_space: Legitimate agent tool parameter lengths and entropy

multi_model_fusion.consensus_logic: Context-aware dynamic gating and weighted consensus

Dataset_1_CIC_IoT_2023.domain: Network & IoT Packet Flow Telemetry (46 features, e.g. flow_duration, Header_Length, Protocol Type)

compatibility_with_existing_models.distilbert: INCOMPATIBLE (Numerical network flow features cannot be passed into NLP prompt transformer)
compatibility_with_existing_models.bilstm: INCOMPATIBLE (Packet flows do not represent agent tool-calling sequences; tool vocabulary mismatch)
compatibility_with_existing_models.xgboost: SCHEMA MISMATCH (46 network features != 183 agent tool features; continued Booster training requires exact 183-feature schema)
compatibility_with_existing_models.isolation_forest: DISTRIBUTION MISMATCH (Network packet volumes and durations do not match agent tool argument character/entropy distribution)

Dataset_1_CIC_IoT_2023.recommended_adaptation: Preserve for network-layer IDS sensor module; do not contaminate agent tool-event XGBoost booster without an approved translation schema.

Dataset_2_InjecAgent.domain: Indirect and Direct Prompt Injection in Tool-Integrated AI Agents (1,054 test cases, user & attacker prompts)

compatibility_with_existing_models.distilbert: COMPATIBLE (100% direct match for text inputs and binary injection labels)
compatibility_with_existing_models.bilstm: PARTIALLY COMPATIBLE (Tool calls can be mapped if corresponding to agent tool vocabulary)
compatibility_with_existing_models.xgboost: COMPATIBLE VIA EVENT EXTRACTION (Tool calls and parameter lengths extractable into 183-dim feature schema)
compatibility_with_existing_models.isolation_forest: COMPATIBLE (Parameter character lengths and special character densities match behavioral space)

Dataset_2_InjecAgent.action: Proceed with fine-tuning existing DistilBERT checkpoint and testing generalization on AgentDojo.

Dataset_3_AgentDojo.domain: Agent Security Execution Benchmark (240 runs across 4 suites)
Dataset_3_AgentDojo.action: Preserve as independent evaluation benchmark. Do not train directly on its evaluation tasks.

Dataset_4_BoT_IoT.domain: IoT Network Packet Telemetry (pcap/flow records: pkts, bytes, rate, srate, drate)

compatibility_with_existing_models.xgboost: SCHEMA MISMATCH (Network flow features do not match 183-dim agent event schema)
compatibility_with_existing_models.isolation_forest: DISTRIBUTION MISMATCH (Packet rates do not match agent argument entropy space)

Dataset_4_BoT_IoT.recommended_adaptation: Document incompatibility. Maintain strict separation from agent application-layer models.

Dataset_5_UNSW_NB15.domain: Network Intrusion Telemetry (49 flow features: dur, proto, service, spkts, dpkts, sbytes)

compatibility_with_existing_models.xgboost: SCHEMA MISMATCH (49 network flow features != 183 agent event features)

Dataset_5_UNSW_NB15.recommended_adaptation: Document incompatibility. Do not force disparate network schema into agent booster.

Dataset_6_CICIDS2017.domain: Network Flow Security Events (78 features: Flow Duration, Total Fwd/Bwd Packets, Flow Bytes/s)

compatibility_with_existing_models.xgboost: SCHEMA MISMATCH (78 network flow features != 183 agent event features)

Dataset_6_CICIDS2017.recommended_adaptation: Document incompatibility. Strict compliance with user's instructions not to force incompatible schemas.
